intro.zh: 从想弄懂的问题开始，找到乐理、乐器、音乐史和词典里的具体内容。
intro.en: Start with a question, then find a useful entry in theory, instruments, history or the glossary.

description.zh: 先选方向，再安排练习。
description.en: Choose a direction and find a way to practise.

description.zh: 找到适合自己的起点。
description.en: Find a starting point that fits you.

description.zh: 把乐理和演奏放在一起学。
description.en: Connect theory with playing.

description.zh: 从一个具体问题安排练习。
description.en: Build practice around one specific problem.

description.zh: 看懂音符，也能跟着节拍听。
description.en: Read the notes and follow the beat.

description.zh: 认识谱线和音符的位置。
description.en: Understand lines and note positions.

description.zh: 看懂音符与休止符的时值。
description.en: Read note and rest durations.

description.zh: 听一听不同拍号的差别。
description.en: Listen to the difference between metres.

description.zh: 从音与音的关系理解音乐。
description.en: Explore how notes relate to each other.

description.zh: 比较两个音之间的距离。
description.en: Compare the distance between two notes.

description.zh: 认识旋律常用的音高材料。
description.en: Explore the pitches used in melodies.

description.zh: 听几个音合在一起的效果。
description.en: Hear how notes sound together.

description.zh: 从声音、结构和演奏方式认识乐器。
description.en: Discover instruments through sound and playing.

description.zh: 了解键盘、琴弦与触键。
description.en: Explore keys, strings and touch.

description.zh: 认识钢弦吉他的发声与用途。
description.en: Learn how a steel-string guitar works.

description.zh: 认识两根弦与运弓发声。
description.en: Explore its two strings and bowing.

description.zh: 把听到的风格放回时代与生活。
description.en: Connect musical styles with their time and setting.

description.zh: 从歌剧、协奏曲与赋格认识这一时期。
description.en: Explore opera, concertos and fugues.

description.zh: 认识乐句、曲式与公共音乐会。
description.en: Discover phrasing, forms and public concerts.

description.zh: 从号子、山歌和小调听起。
description.en: Start with work songs and folk melodies.

description.zh: 遇到陌生词，先查清它在说什么。
description.en: Look up unfamiliar words as you read.

description.zh: 查音乐快慢与相关标记。
description.en: Look up speed and tempo markings.

description.zh: 查谱面上的强弱记号。
description.en: Decode loudness markings in a score.

description.zh: 理解音与音怎样连接。
description.en: Understand how notes connect.

intro.zh: 从写歌、编曲到录音和混音，按手头要做的事找内容。
intro.en: Find a starting point for songwriting, arranging, recording or mixing.

description.zh: 从一句想法发展出旋律与和声。
description.en: Develop an idea into melody and harmony.

description.zh: 看清从想法到 Demo 的过程。
description.en: Follow the steps from idea to demo.

description.zh: 把短小材料发展成音乐。
description.en: Develop a small musical idea.

description.zh: 为旋律寻找和声材料。
description.en: Find harmonic material for a melody.

description.zh: 用软件录下、编辑和组织音乐。
description.en: Record, edit and organize music in software.

description.zh: 认识工程、轨道与时间线。
description.en: Get to know sessions, tracks and the timeline.

description.zh: 编辑 MIDI 的音高和时值。
description.en: Edit MIDI pitch and note length.

description.zh: 调整力度与细微时差。
description.en: Shape velocity and small timing differences.

description.zh: 从录音准备开始处理声音。
description.en: Start with preparation and follow the recording.

description.zh: 提前检查工程、设备与录音安排。
description.en: Prepare the session, equipment and recording plan.

description.zh: 调整话筒位置与录音环境。
description.en: Work on microphone placement and the room.

description.zh: 按问题选择处理环节。
description.en: Choose processing for specific problems.

description.zh: 先处理平衡，再看整体声音。
description.en: Start with balance, then consider the whole track.

description.zh: 用推子安排声音的前后关系。
description.en: Set the foreground and background with faders.

description.zh: 理解整体处理与单轨处理的分工。
description.en: Separate bus processing from track-level fixes.

description.zh: 了解混音完成后的处理与交付。
description.en: Understand what follows the finished mix.

description.zh: 选路线、写要求，再判断结果。
description.en: Choose an approach, describe the brief and judge the result.

description.zh: 按修改需求选择生成方式。
description.en: Choose a route based on your editing needs.

description.zh: 写清风格、编制与段落要求。
description.en: Describe style, instrumentation and form.

description.zh: 按结构、演唱和声音检查结果。
description.en: Review form, performance and sound.

description.zh: 围绕画面、循环和分轨安排音乐。
description.en: Plan music for picture, loops and stems.

description.zh: 从需求与场景安排配乐步骤。
description.en: Organize work around the brief and scenes.

description.zh: 了解分轨、命名与交付要求。
description.en: Plan stems, names and delivery formats.

description.zh: 检查循环点、分层与状态切换。
description.en: Work on loop points, layers and state changes.
